plainTranslation: Your drive meets resistance, often through other people. Tension, competition, a clash of wills. Assert yourself without steamrolling; pick the fight that matters and drop the rest.
policy: Transit-to-natal entries are ordered: transiting planet to natal point. Do not apply same-moment aspect exclusions. Interpret as an active pressure or opening, not a guaranteed event.
